traits.name: Draconic Ancestry
traits.desc: At level 1, you choose a type of draconic ancestor (subrace); it determines your Breath Weapon's damage type and your Resistance.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.desc: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.desc: In place of an attack, you exhale damage in a 15-foot Cone or a 30-foot Line (damage type determined by your draconic ancestry). Dexterity saving throw; the damage increases with level.

traits.name: Draconic Flight
traits.desc: Starting at level 5, as a Bonus Action you can gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed for 10 minutes.
